verdict.reasoning: The printed page (IV-10, 300 dpi render) shows '4.2.2.2.2 Numeric Literals' in the same plain typewriter style as every other numbered heading on the page (4.2.2.2.1.1, 4.2.2.2.1.2, 4.2.2.2.1.3, 4.2.2.2.3). page-156.md line 25 reproduces it word for word ('4.2.2.2.2 Numeric Literals'), in its correct position, followed by the full clause text. The claim's own pdf_says and markdown_says are identical. The only difference is that the markdown does not add '####' heading markup, and it leaves the sibling headings 4.2.2.2.1.x and 4.2.2.2.3 on this page unmarked too. That is markdown formatting, which the PDF does not print. No text is missing and no meaning changes: the clause number and title are present, so the clause can still be found and cited.
